name: FCW
recent: FCW 于 2026 年 11 月 26 日公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日止季度的合并业绩，新闻标题显示该季度营收下降 10.3% 并转为税前亏损。公司于 2026 年 9 月 4 日举行第 71 届常年股东大会，所有决议均获股东通过。董事会及委员会出现人事变动，Woo Hin Weng 于 2026 年 11 月 1 日卸任相关职务，Teh Kay Yeong 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日卸任。
notable: 第 71 届常年股东大会于 2026 年 9 月 4 日举行，所有决议均以投票方式获股东通过。
Woo Hin Weng 于 2026 年 11 月 1 日卸任董事及审计、提名、薪酬委员会职务。
Teh Kay Yeong 于 2026 年 9 月 30 日卸任董事及审计委员会职务。
risks: 新闻标题显示最近季度营收下降 10.3% 并录得税前亏损。

recent_en: FCW announced its consolidated results for the quarter ended 30 September 2026 on 26 November 2026, with a news headline indicating revenue fell 10.3% and the group swung to a pre-tax loss. The company held its 71st Annual General Meeting on 4 September 2026, where all resolutions were approved by shareholders. There were board and committee changes, with Woo Hin Weng ceasing office on 1 November 2026 and Teh Kay Yeong on 30 September 2026.
notable_en: The 71st Annual General Meeting was held on 4 September 2026 and all resolutions were approved by shareholders via poll.
Woo Hin Weng ceased to be a Director and member of the Audit, Nomination and Remuneration Committees on 1 November 2026.
Teh Kay Yeong ceased to be a Director and member of the Audit Committee on 30 September 2026.
risks_en: A news headline indicates the latest quarter saw revenue fall 10.3% and a pre-tax loss was recorded.
